notes.baseline: Always the strongest tier on every task, one call. Change it only with a new preregistration (CONCEPT-0122).
notes.baseline_retest: Control arm: the same policy as the baseline, run again. If it is not non-inferior at delta, delta is below the baseline's own noise (ADR-2306 decision 2).
notes.delta: Non-inferiority margin on the success rate. A placeholder default: derive it per CONCEPT-0121 section 4 and fix it BEFORE the run.
notes.route_rule: Static rule by the corpus label: a hand-written stand-in for the OS router, not a learned policy.
notes.cascade: Small tier first; escalate when the NON-oracle visible check fails (format, visible examples). Tokens of every attempt are counted.
